 Order
This matter is taken up through hybrid mode.

2. The dispute involved in this case is with regard to payment of interest to the Petitioner on the compensation awarded for acquisition of land under the National Highways Act, 1956 (for brevity,
'the Act').
3. Mr. Tripathy, learned counsel for the Petitioner relies upon the ratio in the case of Union of India v. Tarsem Singh, reported in (2019) 9 SCC 304 and submits that the provision under Section 80 of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Reason: Authentication Land Acquisition,
Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 (for Date: 04-Sep-2025 20:30:26brevity, the '2013 Act')
with regard to payment of interest is applicable to the award under the Act.
4.

sentences.text: He, however, prays for an adjournment of four weeks to file a detail counter affidavit keeping in mind the aforesaid case law and the provision under the 2013 Act.

5. Let the counter affidavit be filed within a period of four weeks hence serving a copy thereof on the learned counsel for the Petitioner.
6. Put up this matter on 10th October, 2025.
